messages.subject: Dynamic UI & actionButton
parts:
Hi,

I have a question about actionButton when using dynamic UI (creating action button on the fly). Basically I have a vector containing names, each time this vector is changed I create one actionButton per name. ActionButton'id are recycled.

UI.R
shinyUI(bootstrapPage(
  actionButton('bt_apply', label='Apply'),
  uiOutput('list_bt')
))

Server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  datas <- reactiveValues(bt = c())
 
  observe({
    if(input$bt_apply != 0){
      isolate({
        datas$bt = paste0('idn', 1:round(runif(1, 0, 10)))
      })
    }
  })
 
  output$list_bt <- renderUI({
    html = ''
    for(i in datas$bt)
      html = list(html, actionButton(i, label = i))
    return(html)
  })
 
  observe({
    for(i in datas$bt)
      print(input[[i]]) # how to know which button was pressed ?
  })
})


Do you have any idea how can I detect wich actionButton was pressed ? THX !
